onboarding_0_body: Fortuna is a local-first personal asset and liability record. It needs no account and does not replace bank or broker statements. Uninstalling or clearing app data may delete the ledger, so back up regularly. Fortuna does not provide investment advice or execute trades.
onboarding_1_body: Confirm your language, primary currency, and default amount visibility. Other currencies are converted using cached rates. You can change all of these later in Settings.
onboarding_2_body: Create a bank, broker, fund platform, or liability account first. Use a single-product account for one balance; use a portfolio account when one provider contains several securities, funds, deposits, or cash.
onboarding_3_body: Account details hold balances, principal changes, trades, and subscriptions. Plan compares targets you define yourself. Charts show history, realised P&L, and category, institution, and currency allocation. Quotes and rates may be delayed and never replace official statements.
onboarding_4_body: Your ledger stays on this device by default. Rate and quote updates send public currency or instrument identifiers to data providers. Calendar, sharing, export, and automatic snapshots use system capabilities only after you act or grant access.
onboarding_single_body: Best for property, cash, or one balance or product.
onboarding_portfolio_body: Best for several products, holdings, and cash at one bank, broker, or platform.
onboarding_final_note: Start by adding one asset or liability. If you already have a Fortuna Excel backup, go straight to Settings to restore it.
guide_intro: Fortuna connects scattered assets, market prices, allocation plans, and user-authorised data workflows into one local-first loop. This guide follows the app's current features.
guide_why_fortuna_title: How Fortuna differs from a typical asset tracker
guide_why_fortuna_body: First, it consolidates banks, brokers, fund platforms, property, and liabilities into one balance sheet. Second, it refreshes supported A-share, Hong Kong, US equity, ETF, OTC fund, US option, precious-metal, and FX prices or rates so you do not have to check every platform. Third, it links top-level and nested allocation plans directly to accounts, holdings, and cash, showing real progress without double counting. Fourth, the ledger stays local by default: export an image or Excel report, make a restorable Excel backup, or authorise a machine-readable JSON snapshot for your own cloud drive or AI workflow. Quotes may be delayed; external workflows are chosen by the user, and Fortuna does not provide built-in AI investment advice.
guide_quick_start_body: The bottom tabs are Assets, Plan, Charts, Accounts, and Settings. Add an account under Assets, then open it to record a balance or holdings. The eye button temporarily masks amounts; Settings controls the default.
guide_navigation_body: Assets is the overview and entry point; Plan compares your own targets; Charts shows trends and allocations; Accounts is a read-only institution summary; Settings controls display, currencies, categories, backup, and snapshots. Tap an account for details or long-press it for edit, archive, and delete actions.
guide_account_models_body: A single-product account stores an amount directly. A portfolio account treats a bank, broker, or platform as a container for several products, securities, and cash. Stocks, ETFs, funds, and options use quantity and price; deposits, bonds, and wealth products can use balance-mode products.
guide_records_body: Ordinary accounts accept amount snapshots. Deposits, wealth products, receivables, loans, and credit cards can record principal increases, repayments, spending, or payments; Fortuna derives the balance and also supports a direct balance adjustment. Precious metals use grams, transaction prices, and moving-average cost.
guide_holdings_body: Portfolio accounts support products or holdings, buys and sells, subscriptions and redemptions, and balance corrections. Fully sold positions move to history and return after a new purchase. Total P&L combines realised and unrealised results. US options use structured contract details and a contract multiplier.
guide_quotes_body: FX uses Frankfurter; metals use an international spot service; securities, funds, and options use the relevant public market-data service. Fortuna shows the last valid cache first and refreshes in the background. Closed markets, delays, failures, or incomplete symbols can leave old prices, so check price dates and official statements.
guide_allocation_body: Set an optional target total, top-level targets, and subcategories, then link accounts, holdings, or portfolio cash. One resource can be split by amount across targets and is never double-counted. Lower balances can proportionally reduce claims and produce warnings. Gaps only compare your own targets and are not trade advice.
guide_charts_body: View total assets, liabilities, net worth, and category or account history across time ranges, plus monthly realised P&L and product, institution, and currency allocation. Historical conversion depends on cached rates and record completeness.
guide_archive_body: Archiving preserves all history but removes an account from active totals and plans; it can be restored. Deleting removes the account, records, holdings, and trades and cannot be undone. Fully sold holdings are archived automatically in their history section.
guide_backup_body: Assets can export an image report or category spreadsheet. The Settings Excel file is a complete backup with accounts, records, holdings, plans, settings, and cached rates. Restore asks before replacing current data. Files are not encrypted, so back up current data first and store copies securely.
guide_snapshot_body: Android can optionally write a machine-readable JSON file to any folder; it is off by default. Once enabled, changes or backgrounding update the file. Every active account is included and focus accounts are labels only. A cloud-backed folder may sync the snapshot off-device.
guide_calendar_body: A credit-card detail page can add its monthly due day to the system calendar. The system confirms creation. Fortuna does not make payments and cannot guarantee that the calendar will alert you.
guide_privacy_body: The ledger lives in the app's IndexedDB. Quote requests send only public currency, metal, fund, or security identifiers, not account balances. Sharing, Excel, calendar, and folder access are user-triggered. Android system backup may include app data. Uninstall, clear-data, or device failure can still cause loss.
guide_limitations_body: Fortuna is a record and estimation tool, not an accounting, tax, bank, or broker system. Retry a failed load and check connectivity; do not uninstall merely to troubleshoot. Reconcile official statements, quote and rate dates, and allocation warnings, and keep more than one backup.
not_investment_advice: Allocation gaps, returns, and valuations are for personal records and review only. They are not investment, tax, or legal advice and never execute trades.
